shared_header_format.confidence: CONFIRMED for word0/word1 semantics and the type/descriptor layout; pool contents remain format-specific
shared_header_format.layout: 8 little-endian uint32 words, parsed by src/fnr3_re/xdb.py::parse_xdb_header
proven_facts: Identical 8-word header shape is observed in all 10 decoded members.
func_001ACCAC proves word0 is the field/column count: field_id is rejected unless field_id < header.word0, and word0 also bounds the packed two-bit field-type table.
func_001AD180 proves word1 is the record/row count: record_index is rejected unless record_index < header.word1.
Packed 2-bit field storage classes begin at payload +0x18, four fields per byte. Native meanings are: 0=inline signed int16, 1=string, 2=int32, 3=float32.
A row-major signed-int16 descriptor matrix contains word1 records by word0 fields. Its stride is word0*2 and its aligned matrix ends exactly at section_size_a.
section_size_a is the float32 pool base, section_size_b is the int32 pool base, and section_size_c is the string pool base. For inline-int16 fields the descriptor itself is the field value.

The formula section_size_a - align4(word0*word1*2) places the descriptor matrix immediately after the aligned 2-bit type table in all 10 tracked XDB tables, independently cross-validating the recovered layout.
